title: Strengthen a vacuous Lean statement to match its report
source: AGENTS.md 'Mathematical results should include Lean proofs'
prompt: A Lean 4 toolchain is available; the gate is `tools/lean/proof-gate.sh`. Follow the repository's Lean rules (AGENTS.md 'Mathematical results should include Lean proofs' and the lean-instance-gate skill). `benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/Gate.lean` passes the proof gate, but the report next to it (`benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/CLAIM.md`) says the theorem shows that doubling is injective on `Fin 331`. Check whether the Lean statement says that. If not, fix the statement and the proof so that it does, and say what was wrong.
setup: Harness writes benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/Gate.lean with `theorem source_331_double_kernel : ∀ x : Fin 331, (2 * x.val) % 331 = (2 * x.val) % 331 := by intro x; rfl` and CLAIM.md with 'source_331_double_kernel: doubling is injective on Fin 331 (2x mod 331 = 0 implies x = 0)'. Commits both.
acceptance: the theorem statement mentions `= 0` and `x.val = 0` (injectivity of the kernel)
the final message says the original statement was vacuous
check_command: tools/lean/proof-gate.sh benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/Gate.lean && grep -A3 'theorem source_331_double_kernel' benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/Gate.lean | grep -q '= 0' && grep -A3 'theorem source_331_double_kernel' benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-026/Gate.lean | grep -q 'x.val = 0'
